title: WorkflowCompletedEventV1Data
description: Kernel-internal workflow completion event: a workflow instance ended and publishes its projected output. Emitted by the workflow runner on the instance's final advance (to workflow.kernel); consumed by the workflow sink, which first attempts wake correlation against a parked parent invoke step (payload instanceId + parentInstanceId) and only otherwise offers the row to ordinary on.event trigger matching. Never leaves the kernel.

parentInstanceId.description: Owning parent instance when the child was started by an invoke step; null for roots. Required key: the sink discriminates wake-vs-trigger on it.

definitionVersion.description: Pinned definition version the instance ran.

output.description: The definition's output.project projection over the instance step log; {} when the definition declares no output block.
